purpose: Research registry of external G2P/IPA comparator systems and IPA/source-script display fonts. Entries are not active runtime dependencies; system smoke results are not pronunciation gold data.

integration_contract.pipeline: source orthography -> language-specific structural/phonological analysis -> typed IPA result -> ClippyFirst IPA-to-Ukrainian adapter -> practical Ukrainian orthography
prohibited: silently rewriting external output into IPA without a documented conversion
using unverified output as gold data

candidates.name: Google Language Resources Burmese Thrax/OpenFst G2P
candidates.output: Pinned source commit a90601024f07ab7e96c911243324e0adeb16da96; my/burmese.grm compiles to a weighted OpenFst G2P transducer. The LREC 2020 paper says the output tape is IPA and the grammar composes orthographic, syllable-position, phonological and exception rewrites; 88 phone symbols include tone/phonation variants. Optional workflow now builds and smoke-tests it; no independent project gold exists.
candidates.license: Google Language Resources repository declares Apache-2.0; the workflow pins the repository commit. Its WORKSPACE still references some upstream dependencies without content-addressed pins.

candidates.name: WSSANLP 2016 Myanmar G2P comparison
candidates.output: 25,300-entry MLC pronunciation dictionary: 25,000 train words, three separate 100-word open test sets and a 100-word closed test. Seven methods compared; paper reports PER and manual voicing/tone/consonant/vowel error review. Phone notation is romanized, not project IPA.
candidates.license: Paper citation only; dataset redistribution rights and exact benchmark data artifacts are not established by the paper citation.

candidates.name: OpenSLR SLR80 Burmese speech corpus
candidates.kind: audio/transcript resource for downstream phonetic validation (not G2P gold)
candidates.output: 2,528 utterances from 20 female native speakers; 9,941 unique words and 22,443 total words. Includes word-segmented orthographic transcripts and audio, but no IPA labels. Useful for future expert audio review, not direct IPA benchmark scoring.
candidates.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 as listed by OpenSLR; preserve attribution and share-alike obligations; review dataset terms before redistributing derived artifacts.

benchmark_protocol.scoring_gate: Only independently adjudicated, non-empty gold_ipa rows are scored.
benchmark_protocol.notes: Registry membership does not establish language support, IPA output semantics, reproducibility, accuracy, or license compatibility. Preserve raw output and record exact versions and model/data licenses.

upstream_evidence.fact: Repository has an optional mya-Mymr runner; project audit notes the upstream documentation flags Burmese as limited due to orthographic ambiguity.
upstream_evidence.caveat: Pin package and map/pre/postprocessor hashes; assess coverage and tones/phonation against adjudicated IPA.

upstream_evidence.fact: README lists Burmese among supported languages and claims IPA phone set and MIT repository license.
upstream_evidence.caveat: No pinned output or model/data-specific license audit.

upstream_evidence.caveat: Not a default dependency; non-commercial restriction needs separate permission for commercial use.

upstream_evidence.engine: Google Language Resources Burmese Thrax/OpenFst G2P
upstream_evidence.fact: The pinned my/burmese.grm builds a weighted finite-state transducer with Myanmar graphemes on input and IPA symbols on output; upstream LREC 2020 paper describes 195 states, 2,966 arcs and a 88-symbol phoneme inventory including tone/phonation variants.
upstream_evidence.caveat: Smoke corpus is structural-only and cannot measure accuracy. The Google repository's WORKSPACE has some non-content-address-pinned dependencies; Bazel build must be verified in CI.

upstream_evidence.fact: The paper compares seven methods on 25,300 dictionary words and three 100-word open test sets; open-test PER for WFST is 14.7%, 11.4%, 15.7%; CRF reaches 15.7% on open3; PBSMT reports 16.1%, 13.1%, 22.0%.
upstream_evidence.caveat: The paper's phone notation is romanized rather than project IPA; data redistribution rights are not established; the results are not scores for the current ClippyFirst engines.

upstream_evidence.fact: OpenSLR lists CC BY-SA 4.0 and describes Burmese audio with word-segmented orthographic transcripts; the 2020 paper reports 2,528 utterances from 20 female native speakers and 9,941 unique words.
upstream_evidence.caveat: No IPA labels; requires expert transcription/annotation before it can contribute to an IPA accuracy benchmark.

scope_note: Historical filename: this registry catalogs both external G2P/IPA comparison systems and display fonts. Fonts are rendering assets, not pronunciation engines.

status_semantics.verified_in_repo: true means the candidate's pronunciation behavior has been validated against project-approved independent gold. A successful smoke or upstream language-support claim does not set this flag.
status_semantics.execution_status: Records whether a candidate was run, blocked, or only reported upstream; it is independent of verified_in_repo.
